method: Headless Chrome, simulated mobile viewport; no physical-device or participant testing

shots.title: 01 · Your connections
shots.description: Individuals, groups, publications and providers share one menu. Shape, labels and subtle materials distinguish them.

shots.title: 02 · Keep people close
shots.description: Choose up to six favourites without changing audiences.

shots.title: 03 · Private conversation
shots.description: Keep a private reply while preparing a separate shared title.

shots.title: 04 · Prepare locally
shots.description: The working title belongs to this relationship. Family is the explicit intended destination.

shots.title: 05 · Cross deliberately
shots.description: Review the exact title and Family audience. Keep it private remains available.
shots.step: Choose Proposal, then Review title for Family.

shots.title: 06 · Family
shots.description: Only the reviewed title arrives in the simulated group. Maya’s private reply stays with Maya.

shots.title: 07 · Membership
shots.description: Group membership and proposal agreement remain distinct. Roles here are fictional samples.

shots.title: 08 · Publication
shots.description: Public reading has a distinct audience label and no private-message composer.

shots.title: 09 · Provider
shots.description: The café is the destination. Staff chat and email are ways to communicate inside that context.

shots.title: 10 · Email source
shots.description: Addresses and the external transport boundary stay visible. Email has its own reply draft.

shots.title: 11 · Selected detail
shots.description: Family receives only reviewed text in simulation. Exclusions unfold on request.
shots.step: Choose Email, Bring a detail to Family, then Review sharing.

shots.title: 12 · Connection security
shots.description: An invitation is not identity verification. This prototype contains no real verification codes.

shots.title: 13 · Deliberate invitation
shots.description: Review the sample identity before creating a demo invitation. Pending is separate from accepted and verified.
shots.step: Choose New connection, incognito identity, then Create demo invitation.

shots.title: 14 · Preview control
shots.description: Hide menu snippets explicitly. This is visual concealment, not authentication.
